note: Washington County park near Scottsburg, on an 88-acre lake. Paved electric/water sites that overlook (and slope toward) the lake. Steep narrow ~8% entrance - passable, bring leveling blocks. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $35, lake, phone, county operator. Added year-round, phone booking, $5 entry, showers/dump. Note cleaned. Amps not stated.
flags: WATER: stored 'lakefront' looks right: pin sits in the paved loop on the north shore, open ground to the water on imagery. No per-site map read (campsites page maps are images, not viewed). Not re-audited.

ENTRY FEE: page does not say whether campers pay the $5 daily entry; recorded as stated. Office closed weekends in winter and on Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's, which matters for a phone-only booking.
